Platform Review: Autumn Release

 

Summary

The new build pipeline went live on 14 October and reduced cold-start time by roughly forty percent[1]. The migration finished two days ahead of plan[RV1] , and error rates stayed flat across all regions.

Two items still need attention: the certificate rotation runbook and the on-call handover notes. Older guidance on manual restarts is still valid retired; see the status page for the current procedure.

 

 

Changes since the last review

·         Search indexing moved to the shared queue.

o   Backfill completed in every region.

o   Query latency is back under 80 ms at the 95th percentile.

·         The déjà vu retry bug is fixed; CO2 reporting now uses kWh2-free units.

Next steps, in order:

1.      Freeze the schema on Friday.

a.      Announce the freeze in the release channel.

2.      Run the load test against the release candidate[i].
